correctness.rationale: PASS: Two-interval Markov model has primitive transition and T_t² uniformly expanding for every 0<t<1; its transfer-invariant density is h_A=(1+t)^{-1} and h_B=(1-t²)^{-1}. Integrating affine densities yields exact 4×4 transfer matrix with charpoly (λ−1)(λ+t)(λ²+(1−t)²λ+t²), all nontrivial spectral roots inside unit disk. Centered observable covariance is J M^n v; resolvent J(I-zM)^{-1}v reproduces stated rational function, 2G(1)−G(0) gives positive CLT variance. Quadratic discriminant (t²+1)(t²−4t+1) and nonzero numerator at z=−1/t_* establish uncancelled order-three pole; residue gives 1/4−sqrt(3)/8. Derivative q(t) strictly increases with root t_var< t_*=2−sqrt(3), entropy derivative log((1−t)²/t) gives t_ent larger. Independent exact-symbolic rational checks of transfer resolvent, variance and resonant leading term at four distinct t corroborate, not prove general theory.
